name: contentful-archive-helper
description: Full-stack Contentful app: inbound link insights, safe unlink, App Actions

scripts.build: npm run build -w @archive-helper/shared-types && npm run build -w @archive-helper/shared-utils && npm run build -w @archive-helper/contentful-adapters && npm run build -w @archive-helper/domain && npm run build -w @archive-helper/backend-standalone && npm run build -w @archive-helper/backend-functions && npm run build -w @archive-helper/sidebar
scripts.build:contentful: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @archive-helper/sidebar && contentful-app-scripts --ci build-functions --manifest-file ./contentful-app-manifest.json --esbuild-config ./contentful.esbuild.config.cjs && node scripts/stage-contentful-bundle.cjs
